title: Install and preflight the hourglass candidate on the physical pair
outcome: Install WellSpent 0.2.0 (6) through Xcode's paired Watch destination and independently verify both installed components before the physical design walkthrough.

included: Use a separate physical-device checkout so Xcode cannot rewrite the frozen CI/archive source.
Install and launch the production app through one Xcode-owned paired destination, preserving any existing user data.
Independently query installed versions, device readiness and counterpart status; record exact installation channel and configuration.
Perform feasible real-device icon and idle/paused/running complication observations and record every unobserved step explicitly.
excluded: Uninstalling, erasing, unpairing, backup restore, oldest-build substitution and personal-content inspection.
Full WAT-24 resilience, multi-hour battery certification, distribution validation, App Store upload and release.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A nondestructive Xcode paired installation is independently confirmed at 0.2.0 (6) on both physical devices with the canonical wired-device readiness preflight passing.

The device observation record distinguishes observed icon/workflow results from pending owner-operated checks, exact archive delivery, and broader release gates; no unobserved behavior is reported passed.
